name: Should I use a full-service remodeling contractor or a countertop fabricator?

mainEntity.name: Should I use a full-service remodeling contractor or a countertop fabricator?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single-source remodeling contractor manages your entire project footprint, including cabinet reinforcement, rough plumbing, gas disconnections, sink mounting, drywall repair, and custom tile backsplashes. Fabricator-only shops strictly cut and lay stone slabs, leaving you to find outside trades for plumbing hookups, electrical disconnects, and wall repairs. Working with a comprehensive renovation contractor gives you a single point of contact who handles the tear-out, slab setting, and final interior finish details together.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full-service contractor coordinates plumbing, carpentry, and tile backsplashes, while stone fabricators typically handle only slab measuring, cutting, and placement.
